id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

submittable.description: Flag to indicate whether the component should dispatch an INPUT_SUBMIT action upon input change.

value.description: The value of this input component.

invalid.description:
Whether this input is invalid.
This is necessary for when the state of the component is not managed by its container.

debounceTime.description: The time, in milliseconds, to debounce calling onChange.

placeholder.description: Content to appear in the input when the input is empty.

fluid.description: Whether the dropdown will take the full width of its parent.

appendedTag.description:
Right-aligned static text, which can be up to 4 characters. Text input greater than 4 characters will
be truncated.

confirmable.description: Whether the input will utilize inline editing and confirmation.
